lines.en: Hey, glad you could make it. Thanks for coming.
Oh, my God, Kyle Louder.
- Hi. - I love you!
Hey, that's why I didn't invite you.
You have to calm down, all right?
Just go get yourself a drink or something.
Oh, yeah, that's what you want. My inhibition's lowered.
Hey, Joey said no autographs.
But if she's getting one, I want one, too.
To Monica, and none of this best wishes crap.
I want love.
Okay, actually, uh, Ma, Matthew was giving me his phone number.
Oh, man!
If I had known I was coming to this party,
I never would have gotten married.
- It's nice to meet you, Rachel. - Nice to meet you.
- Call me. - We will.
Look at you with all the guys.
- Yeah. - I guess you've forgotten all about Joey.
Yeah, well, I guess, I guess I have forgotten about Joey,
and clearly, you've forgotten about Chandler.
Please. Chandler's the love of my life.
Ooh, leather pants. Have mercy.
